mapper.insert: insert into evaluation (book_id, reader_id, score, content) values (#{book_id}, #{reader_id}, #{score}, #{content}) on duplicate key update score = #{score}, content = #{content}, create_time = sysdate()
mapper.select: select e.*, r.name as reader_name from evaluation e join reader_info r on e.reader_id = r.reader_id where e.book_id = #{book_id} order by e.create_time desc
select * from evaluation where book_id = #{book_id} and reader_id = #{reader_id}
select round(avg(score), 1) from evaluation where book_id = #{book_id}
select count(*) from lend_list where book_id = #{book_id} and reader_id = #{reader_id} and back_date is not null

select e.*, r.name as reader_name, b.name as book_name from evaluation e join reader_info r on e.reader_id = r.reader_id join book_info b on e.book_id = b.book_id where b.name like #{search} or r.name like #{search} or e.content like #{search} order by e.create_time desc
mapper.update: update evaluation set reply = #{reply}, reply_time = sysdate() where eval_id = #{eval_id}
